pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 100 °C·d above 0 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1250 °C·d$(). Best near 20 °C; stops above 34 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -10 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6.2-8 (tolerates 5.5-8.8). Roots 1.3 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 95, P 17, K 85 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 74 bu/ac (4 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Barley and Barley Seeds.
